faqs.q: Sec. 18-469. - I.P.M.C. Section 105.2, Alternative materials, methods and equipment.
faqs.a:
Section 105.2. Alternative materials, methods and equipment,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
105.2. Alternative materials, methods and equipment.
The provisions of this code are not intended to prevent the installation of any material
                  or to prohibit any method of construction not specifically prescribed by this code,
                  provided that any such alternative has been approved. An alternative material or method
                  of construction shall be approved where the code official or building code advisory
                  board finds that the proposed design is satisfactory and complies with the intent
                  of the provisions of this code, and that the material, method or work offered is,
                  for the purpose intended, at least the equivalent of that prescribed in this code
                  in quality, strength, effectiveness, fire resistance, durability and safety."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
